**tuna-fonts 0.3.2**: a new icon and a couple of things you asked for. If you have 0.3.x or older, the app will offer it when you open it.

### New
- **New icon:** a tuna made of letters.
- **Change a font's category by hand** ([#6](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/6)). Select one or more fonts, click *Category* in the selection bar and pick one, or set them back to *automatic*. It's saved on your PC.

### Improved
- **Font names are easier to read**: bigger and with more contrast, in the list and the grid. Thanks to everyone on Reddit who pointed it out.

### Downloads
- **`tuna-fonts_0.3.2_x64-setup.exe`**: installer (per user, no admin rights needed). Updates itself.
- **`tuna-fonts_0.3.2_x64-portable.zip`**: portable version; unzip and run `tuna-fonts.exe`.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit. **Not code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time: *More info → Run anyway*.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/new/choose).

---

**En español:** la 0.3.2 trae icono nuevo (un atún hecho de letras), permite cambiar a mano la categoría de una o varias fuentes desde la barra de selección (o volver a la automática) y hace los nombres de las fuentes más grandes y legibles.
